evidence.quote: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent

In light of global economic and financial developments and muted inflation pressures, the Committee will be patient as it determines what future adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate may be appropriate
the labor market remains strong but that growth of economic activity has slowed from its solid rate in the fourth quarter
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation has declined, largely as a result of lower energy prices
Recent indicators point to slower growth of household spending and business fixed investment in the first quarter.

parsed.rationale: The Committee holds rates steady while signaling patience, which implies a pause in hikes, citing slowing growth, muted inflation and global risks. The language leans dovish, but it gives no explicit signal of easing.
